title: Proving Limit Existence Using the Squeeze Theorem
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Prove that lim_{(x, y) -> (0, 0)} (x^2 y^2) / (x^2 + y^2) = 0 using the Squeeze Theorem.

steps.title: Establish Upper Bound Inequality
steps.mathExpression: x^2 \le x^2 + y^2 \implies \frac{x^2}{x^2 + y^2} \le 1 \implies 0 \le \frac{x^2 y^2}{x^2 + y^2} \le y^2
steps.explanation: Multiply the bounded quotient x^2/(x^2+y^2) <= 1 by non-negative factor y^2.

steps.title: Take Limits of Bounding Functions
steps.explanation: Since both outer bounds approach 0, the inner expression is squeezed to 0.
